sections.heading: Scope

sections.content:
### Mandatory requirements
1. #### Modern slavery *
**Engineering and technical - Specialised equipment and spares**
This procurement category has a heightened risk of modern slavery.
You will be asked to provide information about modern slavery risks in your business and any actions you have taken to address these. You can visit the NSW Anti-slavery Commissioner’s GRS webpage for more information.
Do you agree to provide this information?
**Response type**
Checkbox (Agree)
2. #### Scheme membership (SCM4721) *
**Engineering and technical - Specialised equipment and spares**
This procurement category has a mandated scheme.
This category has a mandated scheme, to be awarded this contract you may need to be a member of the Subsidence Advisory NSW Independent Assessment Scheme SCM4721.
Are you a member of SCM4721?
**Response type**
Radio button (Yes/No)
### Opportunity requirements
**1.**
**Request for Tender**
Camden Council invites tenders for Supply and Delivery of Portable Hostile Vehicle Mitigation (HVM) Barrier System. A detailed description of the requirements can be found in Council’s Request for Tender document.
Note: Please disregard the requirements to be a member of the SCM4721 referenced on the buy NSW portal. This is an **open** Tender and Camden Council is not procuring under the NSW Buy scheme.
**Response type**
File upload (Multiple)
